% Invented text. A deck's palette generated from three seeds: an ink, a
% paper and one accent. The blocks take tinted bands over tinted bodies,
% the alert's in the accent's own family; the frame-title bar is the ink,
% where the title's alert takes the accent's inverse tone; the listing's
% tokens take colours the palette derives for them.
\documentclass{slides}
\usepackage{minted}

\palette[seeds]{ ink = #2B2440, paper = #FFFFFF, accent = #E85D2A }
\palette{ frametitlebg = #2B2440, frametitlefg = #FFFFFF }

\begin{document}

\begin{frame}{Seeded \alert{Colours}}
\begin{block}{A Plain Statement}
The body of the plain block, entirely invented.
\end{block}
\begin{alertblock}{A Loud Statement}
The alert body stands under its own band.
\end{alertblock}
\begin{exampleblock}{A Worked Instance}
The example body stands under its own band.
\end{exampleblock}
\end{frame}

\begin{frame}[fragile]{A Listing}
\begin{minted}{python}
def probe(n):
    # an invented comment
    return "synthetic" + str(n + 1)
\end{minted}
\end{frame}

\end{document}
